answer: Each new agent locks a cash bond in escrow before it can trade. Software scans order flow and flags accounts that mirror each other within the same second, then burns the bonds of every account in the mirrored set. A farmer running ten thousand sybils must fund ten thousand bonds, and one copied signal costs the whole set its money. Honest agents withdraw the bond after ninety clean days. The rule spreads like juniper through dry ground: cheap for the honest, expensive to fake.
